Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The urine analysis shows significant leukocyturia, positive nitrites, presence of bacteria, and >100,000 CFU/mL E. coli in culture, indicating a urinary tract infection. Mild hematuria is present. Low specific gravity may reflect dilute urine. No casts or ketones detected. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy.
